rules.summary: Human Markdown is durable review state; STATUS.md is generated and machine/runtime evidence lives only under _kapelle/.
rules.title: ARCH-01

rules.summary: Each logical artifact has one physical path; recovery reports evidence honestly and never fabricates approval, validation, review, or historical telemetry.
rules.title: ARCH-02

rules.summary: Recovered coordination graphs are provisional: validation-only is allowed for existing work, but code-writing, feature review, and ship require refreshed architecture guidance and decomposition.
rules.title: ARCH-03

rules.summary: Validation and review freshness covers human documents, normalized coordination graphs, and the actual implementation files.
rules.title: ARCH-04

rules.summary: Migration performs complete preflight before mutation and writes its success marker only after rebuilt-state validation.
rules.title: ARCH-05

rules.summary: Utilities are deterministic and local: no shell, network, git mutation, or provider-specific routing.
rules.title: ARCH-06
